components.name: Description list item
components.description: One term · value pair. Justified — value right-aligned (prices, receipts); Columns — fixed 152 term column, value wraps (specifications); Inline — “Term: value” (compact cards). Term text/secondary, value text/primary, size = Body/S·M·L. Leader — dotted line (border/default) when the eye must travel far. Totals: override the Value text style with Body Strong. React: <DescriptionList.Item layout

components.name: Description list
components.description: Title + five items + optional Total (Divider + Body Strong) and “Show all” Link. Swap or add items as needed; keep 3–8 rows, more → collapse behind Show all. React: <DescriptionList title>.
